assertions.name: Frobenius moment Gram is PSD (well-posed channel geometry)

description: Operator-selection LP/SDP (prop:operator-selection-lp; lp_dual_solver) over the inter-molecular sub-braid channels {1, σ₁ (H-bond), σ₁² (Hopf link 𝓛_H = T_{2,2}, Vol=0, symmetric carrier e₊)} with canonical Markov traces t_i=tr_M(b_i) and Frobenius moment Gram G_{ij}=tr_M(b_i b_j). Reads the dual: y0*=binding-energy density, y_i*=channel saturation prices, active_set='receptive sub-braids'. Computes the e₊/e₋ q-dims and σ₁² block weights. NOTE (per prop:vdw-pskew-isolation): e₊ is the retained cosh CARRIER, NOT van der Waals; vdW is the discarded bar-odd residual sinh(2λ)(e₊−e₋). EXPLORATORY / off-label: the operator-selection SDP is canonically the magic-A binding selector; the verdict reflects this inter-molecular channel/target choice.

data.finding: The operator-selection SDP on the Hopf channel, in two parts. (1) The naive sub-braid basis {1, σ₁, σ₁²} is RANK-DEFICIENT (Gram rank 2, one zero eigenvalue): σ₁² = hσ₁+1 is not independent in H_2(q), so 'the Hopf σ₁² channel' is NOT separate from {1, σ₁} at 2 strands. (2) The independent Wedderburn idempotents ARE the channels: the symmetric block e₊ (trivial rep, q-dim 0.7527) is the Hopf/[2]_q CARRIER (Vol=0); the antisymmetric block e₋ (q-dim 0.2473) is the directional H-bond channel. The Hopf link decomposes σ₁² = q²·e₊ + q⁻²·e₋ = 60.3% symmetric. CORRECTED FRAMING (per prop:vdw-pskew-isolation): e₊ is the RETAINED cosh carrier, NOT van der Waals — vdW is the DISCARDED bar-odd residual sinh(2λ)(e₊−e₋) (small, absent from the main mass/binding formula). The earlier 'vdW = the symmetric block e₊' label is superseded. Exploratory/off-label: the operator-selection SDP is canonically the magic-A binding selector; the channel/target setup is the modelling input.
